<div class="card-body">
'''They're On Dantooine''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">基地はダントゥインにあるわ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1ゲームに1回だけ、2フォースを使用してダントゥインに配備できる。デス・スターを目標とする。相手は目標がダントゥインに到達してウーティーニ・エフェクトをキャンセルするまで「第一次点火開始」を使用できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Theyre-On-Dantooine-PSA-89673880.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ご自分の星が標的になるのはお嫌でしょうな。もっと軍事的に重要な星に目標を変えてもいいんですよ。あなたがその星の名前をいうのなら！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' They're On Dantooine.

'''Card text:'''
Once per game, use 2 Force to deploy on Dantooine. Target the Death Star. The opponent cannot use Commence Primary Ignition until the target reaches Dantooine and cancels this Utinni Effect.

'''Lore:'''
You would not like your own planet to be the target, would you. You may change the target to a more militarily important planet, if you name that planet!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The printed title is 基地はダントゥインにあるわ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[They're On Dantooine]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
